Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break news leads with Amazon's $500 price cut on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, along with other equally attractive deals: AirPods Pro 3 "July Black Friday" discounts kick off, AirPods Max reduced by $100, AirTag 2 returns to historical low; if you act fast, the cellular Apple Watch Series 11 also hits a new low with $150 off. There's also Twelve South's PowerBug combining a wall charger and MagSafe stand at 30% off, the MagSafe iPhone Air external battery at 60% off, and Anker's massive "July Black Friday" discounts starting from $8. See below for details.

"July Black Friday" AirPods deals kick off: AirPods Pro 3 reduced by $50, Max 2 reduced by $100, more options starting from $99

  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $145 (originally $179)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (originally $179 new) — Renewed Premium

2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro sees a massive $500 cut on Amazon today

MacBook pricing had already been hiked previously, but Amazon still slashed $500 off this 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro this morning, a price very close to the lowest level we recorded before the price increase. Details below.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Since this machine has been steadily priced at $2,999 at Apple and other retailers, this means a full $500 discount right now, available in both Space Black and Silver.

Since major retailers completed their price hikes, this is the lowest price we've recorded for the M5 Pro model.

Before today, Amazon's best discount on this machine was only $300, now with an additional $200 off.

Strictly speaking, this price still hasn't reached the low we recorded before the official price increase, but that's unavoidable — there's no turning back now. Taking everything into account, plus the significant price hike about a month ago, this deal is actually very close to the historical lowest price we've tracked for this M5 Pro, just about $100 higher.

If you're looking to upgrade, this deal is really not to be missed.

More MacBook Pro deals worth noting during "July Black Friday" week:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $2,019)
  • Includes a free Apple 96W USB-C charger (valued at $20)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (originally $2,199)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,199 (originally $2,519)
  • Upgrade to 96W Apple charger (valued at $20)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (originally $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,699 (originally $3,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (originally $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (originally $4,399)

Apple AirTag 2 as low as $22 each, one of the best "July Black Friday" deals this year

This week's "July Black Friday" has been rolling out plenty of great deals — besides the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 discount, up to $180 off Apple Watch Series 11, and $100 off AirPods Max 2, the Apple 2026 AirTag 2 4-pack returning to its historical low price is also worth mentioning.

The 4-pack is currently slashed to $99, with each AirTag 2 individually priced at $29, so even buying one separately costs $29, while the 4-pack at the original price of $99 brings the per-unit average down to under $26.

However, this week's historical low of just $89 for the 4-pack works out to just over $22 per unit, an unprecedented price for Apple's latest and most powerful item tracker.

  • AirTag 2 single pack $27 (originally $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

Although the AirTag 2 single pack hasn't reached the low recorded during Prime Day last month, the 4-pack has matched it. This price matches our recorded historical low for the 4-pack in terms of new unit cash discount, and is even better than most open-box pricing.

If you want to pick up Apple's upgraded AirTag this summer, now is the best time.

Apple Watch Series 11 cellular model hits new Amazon low, up to $180 off

If you only want the base model, you can still get one starting from $299, but we're now tracking a series of all-time new Amazon lows and historical lows for the Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell models, from $180 off the regular price: 42mm from the original price down to $350, and the even better value 46mm model also slashed to $350. However, these deals are likely to end very soon.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular $350 (originally $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular $350 (originally $529)

Amazon is now selling the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model for $349.97 with free shipping. Originally $499, that's a direct 30% or $150 off the regular price, the lowest price we've ever recorded — never this cheap during Black Friday or Prime Day.

Amazon is also selling the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model at the same price of $349.97 with free shipping. Considering this version is originally $529, the discount reaches $180, making it an all-time new Amazon low with undeniable appeal.

The only thing to note is color choice — which is normal at this price point. As of writing, only Space Gray is available for this 46mm larger model deal, while the 42mm is available in both Jet Black and Space Gray this morning at this special price.

The 46mm discount is indeed deeper and more attractive, but if you prefer the smaller 42mm, it's just as good a deal — both are unprecedented Amazon prices. Based on the trend of other cellular model special deals during this week's "July Black Friday," these prices are likely to disappear quickly.

Apple iPhone Air MagSafe external battery returns to historical low, sold at 60% off

Ongoing deal: Satechi 25W Space Black metal 3-in-1 MagSafe desktop charger, now at historical low $78 (reduced by $40)

  • Satechi's new MacBook Neo series officially debuts: world's "first" dual-connector expansion port and other highlights
  • Satechi 2026 Mac mini-style Thunderbolt 5 CubeDock slashed to historical low today, $100 off

"July Black Friday" iPhone 17 Pro deals up to $220 off (Amazon Renewed Premium), up to $449 off for 17 Pro Max

We've recorded quite a few opportunities to get a refurbished iPhone 17 Pro this year, and we want to specifically highlight Amazon's top-quality Renewed Premium discounts as a "July Black Friday" feature pick — now with 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee, up to $220 off the iPhone 17 Pro.

"July Black Friday" iPhone 17 Pro deals

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (original new price $1,299)

These listings are shipped and sold by Amazon directly, come with a one-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee warranty, and "greater than 90% original battery life." Besides being Amazon's highest-grade refurbished condition, this is also the main difference between "Amazon Premium Refurbished" and Renewed Premium — you get a full year of warranty and a genuine battery.

True, we've seen cheaper premium refurbished units, but when it comes to the best quality and most worry-free purchase, Amazon's Renewed Premium is always one of the top choices.

As for the larger iPhone 17 Pro Max, the ongoing Woot deal remains very attractive. These are "brand new, unopened, PRISTINE" inventory, complete with "test stickers showing 100% battery life, along with a custom-designed stylish black box." In other words, they're essentially new units, but without Apple original packaging, and "not eligible for AppleCare." However, with discounts of up to $449, it could be worth it for some.

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (originally $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (originally $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (originally $1,999)

Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2 "July Black Friday" $100 off (all colors)

Besides the ongoing $50 off AirPods Pro 3 and AirTag 2 returning to historical low, one of the most attractive "July Black Friday" deals is $100 off the 2026 AirPods Max 2.

Amazon is now selling Apple's latest AirPods Max 2 for $449 with free shipping, a direct $100 off the $549 regular price, the best deal currently available.

All five colors are available for this deal: Midnight, Blue, Orange, Starlight, and Orange.

Aside from the briefly seen price during Prime Day that sold out in many colors before the deal ended, this is the lowest price we've recorded for this generation of Apple over-ear headphones. Since its early-year launch, this is only the second time we've seen a discount of more than $50.

The summer shopping season typically peaks with July's Prime Day, and this year Prime Day came a month early. This "July Black Friday" price for the 2026 AirPods Max 2 is likely the best price for the Max 2 before fall. If you want to grab a pair of headphones for the summer or longer, this $100 discount is likely the lowest price before the official Black Friday shopping season kicks off (or more likely, before the early-bird Black Friday season that has recently started as early as October).

While the exterior looks the same as the previous AirPods Max (USB-C), there are significant internal upgrades, starting with the H2 chip.
